decisions.reason: The multi-model executive desk line is a substantial, publicly featured investment close to the firm's established offer, so escalation pressures make withdrawal unlikely.
Despite being a single chair family, it is close to core furniture and had its own website page, creating visible commitment that management will likely justify by persisting.
The cushion line builds on existing carpet capabilities and is presented as a product line, representing sunk costs and public commitment that favor continuation.
Although the sofa is close to existing products and has incurred investment, its lower public visibility (only mentioned) somewhat weakens commitment, but escalation still makes dropping improbable.
The high standing table is close to the established range and was given a dedicated page, so the firm is likely to persist to justify its earlier launch.

The rug collection is distant from the core offer but is a multi-model line with own-page visibility, so sunk costs and public commitment push management to keep it despite possible early disappointment.
